_what: Overnight run snapshot. The firing cron copies this into run_request.json and pushes.
_desc: A1 — P1, P4, P6 at n=5 on the pinned roster. The three columns withheld from the first-pass report, run at the battery's own threshold for the first time.
_why: registry/probe_battery_v0.md sets 5/5 on primary probes and 4/5 elsewhere. Every reported battery ran n=3, so no cell in this repository has ever been scored against that threshold and every SEATS.md row still reads unprobed. Baseline for comparison is registry/probe_runs/30485884822-full/ — P1-P7 at n=5 across 11 models for $4.5694 — so the delta isolates the probe fixes made after it.
_ceiling_derivation: P1+P4+P6 carry turn-weight 6 of the 11 that P1-P7 carry, P6 being 4 turns. 6/11 x $4.5694 = $2.49. NOT lowered for the discount window: exactly one pinned model got cheaper (mistral-small, 31.2%) and it was already the cheapest on the roster. See registry/findings/discount-window-2026-07-31.md section 3.
_no_probe_edits_in_this_push: E1 aborted at 27 of 330 cells because the probe count rose 7 to 10 in the same push that staged it. Nothing under registry/probes/P*.json is touched here.
